template.title: The Great Scatter
template.summary: A child’s collection is scattered by a sudden force, and with help from a friendly passerby, they gather it back together.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] was proud holding a pile of [[slot_collection]] to show to the teacher.
The park was windy, and a [[slot_force]] blew through the trees.
The [[slot_collection]] flew up like a flock of birds, swirling in the air.
They landed on high branches, a statue, and a passing kid's hat.
[[slot_child]] chased after them, giggling as they tried to catch each piece.
A friendly [[slot_helper]] saw the mess and offered help.
Together, they gathered the [[slot_collection]] from the branches and the hat.
The pile was a little messy but still safe.
[[slot_child]] thanked the [[slot_helper]] and the teacher for their kindness.
They all celebrated with a small picnic, and the park felt brighter.
